detailZones.title: Checkpoint queue and divestiture
detailZones.description: Follow the queue rails, tray stacks, floor stripes and accessible lane.

detailZones.title: Document check podium
detailZones.description: Inspect the document podium, reader housings, glass partition and counter hardware.

detailZones.title: CT and conveyor lanes
detailZones.description: Study the checkpoint scanners, conveyor rollers, trays and operator controls.

detailZones.title: Secondary inspection
detailZones.description: Inspect the hand-search table, swab kit, inspection light and evidence containers.

detailZones.title: Sterile departure exit
detailZones.description: Follow the access pedestal, departure corridor, gate seating and boarding doorway.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 security-checkpoint photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 103 independently pointable queue, document, CT screening, secondary-inspection and sterile-exit parts. Passenger identity, screening outcomes, prohibited items, security performance, operational procedures and written signs were excluded.
